name: android_get_ui_tree
description: Reads the active window UI. format "semantic" (default): a compact digest with [#ID] tags for android_click_element and android_input_text. format "xml": the raw accessibility XML (classes, resource IDs, bounds).

compressed.description: xml only: merge layout containers (default true); false for full Compose/Flutter trees.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
